name: SpeedRunner
summary:
Use your grappling hook, walljumping, doublejumping and other freerunning abilities to speedrun as quickly as possible across 16 action-packed platforming levels, in order to dismantle the bomb in time!

You can re-play levels with newly unlocked gadgets to find the best routes and get the highest scores.

Run, jump and swing to avoid spikes and obstacles, while battling against the mad bomber and his diabolical machine, in this exciting platform-racer with stunning graphics and cool animations.
